expected.title: Field Journal: Explain Why, Where and Whose View
expected.content:
Build a mission report with three questions. Why was the expedition supported? Consider spice access, possible profit and political interests. Where did the westward plan lead? Follow the broad oceans and passage while keeping Philippine islands and Maluku distinct. Whose perspective are we hearing? Compare the sponsor's aims with the interests of people already present.

expected.title: Your Encounter Report
expected.content:
Complete your encounter report. Start with a sequence: Homonhon, Limasawa and Cebu are distinct stops. Name an action: local people provided supplies at Homonhon. Explain communication: interpreters helped people speaking different languages meet. Name a setting: Cebu already had trade and leadership. Finally, identify a source and a limit.

Use this frame in your own words: At [place], [people] took part in [event]. The evidence supports [specific claim]. It does not establish [claim that goes too far]. This is a thinking tool, not a speech from the past.

Check your report. Did you confuse a landing with a sighting? Turn help into surrender? Treat a religious event as everyone's belief? Invent what a leader thought? Revise claims that exceed the clues.
